title: Factorized control type x injection-depth views
hypothesis: A low-description condition-code x injection-depth-code factorization predicts heldout condition-depth spatial operators with at least 25% lower complete serialized bytes than independent adapters and better quality-byte tradeoff than additive sharing.
physical_object: shared spatial control adapter transfer matrices
mirror_coordinate: condition identity coordinate and injection-depth coordinate, combined multiplicatively with a shared interaction basis

development.selection_metric: heldout condition-depth operator nRMSE and complete serialized payload bytes

fresh.reason: synthetic mechanism screen with exact native factorization alias; no fresh audit opened

success_gate: Heldout operator nRMSE <=0.02, >=25% complete payload byte savings vs independent condition-depth adapters, and a strict quality-byte-compute frontier improvement over native additive factorization.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte gate miss or exact native factorization payload/function alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Designed synthetic spatial operator family; no trained diffusion model, ControlNet checkpoint, image generation, or aesthetic evaluation.
Exact known-factor synthetic family estimates an upper-bound mechanism screen, not learned factor recovery.
No near-convergence capacity or hardware runtime claim.
